title: I'm Not A Vampire

[00:41.09]Well, I can lure any woman that I want to in my bed with me

[01:02.29]Coursing through my veins, when did I become so cold?

[01:38.18]My head is always spinning from this dizzy blurry vision and my stomach has had enough
